newsitem.title: JAPAN: USTR's Lang says concerned by Japan's surplus.
newsitem.headline: USTR's Lang says concerned by Japan's surplus.

text.p: Deputy U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) Jeffrey Lang told Reuters on Monday that the United States is concerned about Japan's trade figures.
Asked how concerned USTR was by the nearly 70 percent rise in Japan's overall July trade surplus and the 35 percent rise in its surplus with the United States announced earlier on Monday, Lang said:
"I haven't seen the trade figures this morning, but we are concerned."
Japan's Ministry of Finance announced in the morning that Japan's overall customs-cleared trade surplus in July rose 69.7 percent from a year earlier.
The overall surplus came in at 849.08 billion yen, while the surplus with the United States grew 35.7 percent to 420.55 billion yen.
